title: melampyrum arvense var. semleri
intro: Melampyrum arvense var. semleri, commonly known as Yellow Monkey Flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. It is a parasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting to the roots of other plants, specifically grasses and other herbaceous plants. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, and its health benefits include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Melampyrum arvense var. semleri include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects.
